question: Which inflammatory and functional outcomes are transferred into young recipients?
decision: Distinguish donor age, recipient amplification, and a lineage-dependent genotype contrast in endurance.
strongest_rival: Shared harvest, composition or persistence can explain recipient differences independently of a transferable HSC state.
discriminator: Compare published observation distributions and fixed contrasts within each matching cohort.
exposure_record: Published results and the revised plan were read. Workbook layout and caption counts were inspected before freezing.
biological_unit: Young final recipient. Aged source mouse or marrow-chimera harvest may be shared across recipients.
nesting_and_overlap: Rows can be source values without stable biological identifiers. No row-order pairing, donor independence or cross-panel matching is assumed.
population_and_selection: Released source rows for named Mu et al. panels. Groups and endpoints are separated by panel and study design.
contrast: Old minus young, antibody minus IgG, and T3 minus Cre in their own experiments. Myeloid T3 minus Cre minus T-cell T3 minus Cre for Fig. 7.
endpoint: Recipient serum IL-6, CD68 abundance, IL-6-high fraction and physiology. Time to exhaustion is the primary lineage contrast.
methods: Read exact workbook ranges. Calculate group means and value SEM for arithmetic readback, compare cached summaries, show raw values, calculate signed fixed contrasts.
missingness_and_exclusions: Ignore blank cells within declared observation ranges. Do not use summary rows as observations or impute missing values.
multiplicity: Descriptive endpoints and contrasts only. No significance tests.
precision_basis: Value SEM reproduces reported summary arithmetic. Unknown preparation or cluster structure prevents independent-unit precision claims.
interpretation_limit: Released-value contrasts describe these source groups. No stage-specific causal attribution or donor-level generalization.
stop_rule: Report label, count, or summary mismatches and restrict interpretation. Hold cluster-dependent or paired models without keys.
amendment_reason: Initial frozen descriptive replay from verified revised plan and publisher workbooks.
